summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration_31 fixes (Extras folders at any depth, auto multi-part check after Update Library). Used the simulated electronAPI harness, with TMDB mocked through ctx.route (Mock2 adds a 'Lost' TV hit and a failing-season toggle). All 8 requested scenarios pass. Two new low-priority edge cases were found: a single new episode in a show folder is never auto-matched, and the 'Extras' show-name check only works when file names start with the show name.

ui_bugs.issue: The check only skips the Extras rule when the file title starts with the folder name. Files D:\TV\Extras\Season 1\01 - Pilot.mkv and 02 - Second.mkv are still treated as extras of D:\TV: no Multi-Part button and TV Shows count 0. The suggested 'parent is a library root (or the next folder is a Season folder)' rule was not implemented.

integration_issues.issue: If only ONE new file is added inside a show folder (D:\TV\Lost\Season 1\Lost.S01E01.mkv) and no other card of that show exists, no multi-part group forms. queueAutoMatch skips the file because partFolder().showDir is set, so it is never matched: 0 TMDB calls, no dialog, an empty queue, and the card stays 'Lost S01E01' with no poster. Before this change such a file was auto-matched. Fix: skip only files that end up in an autoMulti group with an existing card, or match lone show-folder files as TV (tvOnly/preferTv).

verified_passing: Show named 'Extras' (Extras.S01E01, S01E02, Season 2\Extras.S02E01): Multi-Part shows group 'Extras', '3 files · whole show' (Season 1 x2, Season 2). TV Shows count is 3 and the TV filter lists the 3 Extras cards.
The Interview Part 1/2 in D:\Movies\The Interview: suggested as a normal group 'The Interview · 2 parts'.

Primary flip fixed: batman_lib(None) + auto='on' + Update Library. Zero TMDB calls before the merge (no search/movie for 'Batman S02E01' or 'Bloopers'), and n1/n2 stayed unmatched. The auto dialog 'New files belong with existing titles' lists Batman with 4 files. After the merge the card is bat, tmdb 5, tv, /bat.jpg, with 4 parts. The only calls were /tv/5/season/1 and /tv/5/season/2. S02E01 got 'S2E1 Name' and the old S1 names were replaced with fresh ones. TV count is 1.

New show Lost (2 new cards, no existing card): no per-episode auto-match and the auto dialog suggests 'Lost'. The merge automatically called /search/tv?query=Lost, then /tv/9 and /tv/9/season/1. The card l1 became tmdb 9 / tv with 2 parts, both with episode names.

Heat + Extras\Trailer: parts list shows sections 'Feature' (row label 'Feature') and 'Extras'. There is no parts-section-parts and no series-info-btn. With Fetch Posters, Heat queried /search/movie first; /search/tv came only as the low-confidence fallback, because the mock's year did not match.
Series toast: 7-file Batman (2 episodes + 5 extras) -> 'Matched series "Batman" — 2 of 2 episodes found'. Merged Batman (3 episodes + 1 extra) -> '3 of 3 episodes found'.
attachEpisodes on a failed season: with season requests returning 500 and Refresh series clicked, all 3 previously attached episode names are kept in storage and in the UI.

Regression: the 7 Batman cards (extras at any depth) form 1 group with Season 1 (2) and Extras (5) sections. Green Planet Part 1..3 is grouped. The merge of 2 titles works (the manual Multi-Part merge of a show now also auto-runs the series lookup). Escape closes the auto dialog without merging and the button stays. 'Not multi-part' closes it, saves the dismissed key ['show|d:\\tv\\batman (1966)'] and hides the button. No page errors in any scenario.
action_items: LOW/MEDIUM: Lone new files in a show folder that join no multi-part group are never auto-matched (queueAutoMatch skips every file with showDir). Queue them for matching (prefer TV) when the autoMulti effect finds no group for them.
LOW: 'Extras' show detection should not depend on file names starting with 'Extras'. Treat a segment as a show folder when its parent is a library root dir or its child is a Season folder.
critical_code_review_comments: If every season request fails, refreshSeriesInfo shows a success toast '0 of 3 episodes found' (the data is kept). A warning toast would be clearer.

mergeGroups now calls refreshSeriesInfo for any merged show group whose card is not tv, including manual Multi-Part merges. That is intended, but it means TMDB calls and a toast on every manual show merge. It also passes the pre-merge closure card, so fine for now.
The test mock's /tv/{id} details always returns the name 'Batman', so the Lost toast read 'Matched series "Batman"'. This is a mock artifact, not an app bug.
LocalLibraryPage.jsx is ~3147 lines (not refactored, as requested).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested scenarios (8/8); 2 new low-priority edge cases

context_for_next_testing_agent: g={'page':page}; exec(open('/app/tests/test_iter32_multipart.py').read(), g); await g['run_names'|'run_batman_flip'|'run_lost'|'run_regression']() inside browser_automation. Edge probes: /app/tests/test_iter32_edges.py run_edges. Mock2 extends X.TmdbMock with a 'lost' -> tv id 9 hit and fail_season=True (500 on season requests).
